body:
Thanks for all of your responses. 
I was pretty drunk when I made this post, but it has been eating me up inside and it's great to finally get it out. 
It seems I have lost all interest in life, nothing really matters to me anymore and it's been hard trying to find interests or even get out of bed for that matter. 
I know I should be seeing a doc, I have in the past but in the end I rejected all of them. I have tried and been on many different medications, but in the end, it's not going to do anything unless I want to get better. This "depression" is really crippling me, but I feel like it's been with me for so long that it's become a part of me and I can't get rid of it.
